value.rationale: A natural complete sharp product-threshold classification for all continuous fast-decaying range affinities, with a quantitative exact nonnegative loss identity and the first explicit monotone-to-nonmonotone failure mechanism on six-site paths. It gives actionable stability criteria for directed local edge-aware smoothing distinct from two-input Lipschitz and from routine positivity of the averaging weights.
